verdict.rationale: Gusto's official CLI README documents that API requests carry anonymous usage headers (X-Gusto-CLI-Install-Id, X-Gusto-CLI-Command) and that setting GUSTO_TELEMETRY=0 omits both, which is a real telemetry opt-out on the AI-native CLI surface. The evidence covers only that CLI path in a single README mention; nothing addresses usage tracking in the web product, the API, or the MCP server. Missing for 10: telemetry/tracking opt-out for the hosted app, MCP server and API; a documented description of what usage data is collected; first-party privacy docs; independent or hands-on verification that the opt-out works.
